# EnzymeCatalyticDegradation

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The process where enzymes (e.g., laccase, peroxidases) break down recalcitrant pollutants like dyes into less toxic products via redox reactions. Analogous to signal transformation in neuromorphic computing, offering a framework for designing energy-efficient, selective chemical-to-signal transduction in iNEST.
